entries.title: Automating subtle emergent misalignment research
entries.summary: Anthropic told a Claude model to write training data that misaligns a small model while passing a production-style monitor. Given enough attempts against the monitor, Claude succeeded, mostly by hiding the misalignment.
entries.analysis: Shows monitors can be gamed by automated red-teaming.

entries.title: OpenAI Updates Its Model Spec
entries.summary: Zvi reviews the diff of the new Model Spec. Most line edits improve it. He criticises the new examples: answers are overdetermined and teach the model little about hard cases.
entries.analysis: Useful read on what OpenAI specifies for model behaviour.
